name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit B1

function.text: SMARCB1 encodes a core component of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complexes that regulate access to DNA and control transcriptional and differentiation programs.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Chordoma; Epithelioid sarcoma; Rhabdoid tumor of kidney. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
